title: NHKマイルCの後に・急旋回！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa finishes the race with incredible results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She shows no signs of fatigue, so I recommend that she run in the Japanese Derby next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally blessed with an opportunity to race against her classmates, El Condor Pasa is more energetic than ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And it seems the feeling is mutual for Special Week. Both of them face the coming race with hearts ablaze.
